## Do you like Codespaces?

I think github codespaces is an incredible tool for developers with so
many features that smooth away some of the rough edges associated with
developing with containers. 

However, if you find yourself to be a fellow R enjoyer, you might
find that the R experience with Visual Studio Code that comes
along for the ride with codespaces is a bit lacking. It can be
made to work, but ultimately I could never get it feeling as good
as good ole RStudio.
